edited: * Core's Stats widget as a remote component (R21): the component
* context, as the widget context, around the widget.
// The context is the mount's, handed once: its sections move, it does not.

steps: clone: core's Stats clones from the admin list into the editor as its own authored component (owner authored.<id>), switched off, compiled clean

edit: typing a line into sessions/stats/Stats.svelte with only "C7 gate authored v1

, and the editor marks it unsaved
preview: Preview mounts the draft in its own box under authored.<id>, drawing the edited string over the preview's fixtures, and stores nothing
save: Save stores the edit and compiles it clean: the editor drops its unsaved mark, and Problems says it compiles
switch on and review: the switch offers it to layouts at /authored-ui/authored.<id>/<hash>.js; its scopes (widget:session:state) wait for review until the review grants them
seat: seated on the Adventure fixture's left side, it draws the edited string in its own box ("Stats", owner authored.<id>), beside core's Stats
not core: a write it makes (Rook's Health, pressed as a person presses) is refused in its own box — "only core's own widgets ask 'set-attribute-value'" — and the server's value and version stay
live reload: another browser context's save reaches the open session page in place — the widget remounts on the new build with no navigation, and the old string is gone

compile error: a broken line is named in Problems at its place (sessions/stats/Stats.svelte:27:<col>, "Unexpected token"), on Preview (which keeps the last good build) and on Save; saved broken, it is kept as a draft — the session keeps showing the last good build, in place; the editor reopens on the draft under its banner, and Revert to last save puts it back on the saved source
export: Export downloads stats.component.json: a component@1 share file with the saved source, its base and its built artifact
import: importing the file lands a copy — its own id, switched off, its scopes waiting for review — holding the exported source

a non-admin: a signed-in non-admin is sent away from /admin/components, gets no answer from the component verbs and changes nothing with them (a switch-on and a delete sent straight on the socket leave the import as it was), and the admin's /component-preview URL is a 404 for them (200 for the admin)
delete: Delete (confirmed) removes both from the list and the server; a session page open on it shows it as missing in place, and loaded afresh draws nothing of it
